title: Independently certify P104 intrinsic dual endpoint columns
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Independent implementation/corroborating certificate: the final overlap refresh discovered [Discussion2647](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2647), a parallel Arham Tahir Codex session taking the same bridge. No novelty or priority claim is made. This package adds a closed-form all-column oracle with no retained interpreter/compiler imports; it explicitly assumes the middle, whereas the parallel claim also plans a full predecessor replay. The original Discussion2646 points to that shared investigation.

PR2586 explicitly leaves intrinsic endpoint conversion outside its canonical physical inverse-transpose theorem. This package supplies the 104 source-entry and 104 target-exit conjugated monomials, proves their wrapper direction, and checks all 106,496 basis columns with exact Gaussian integers including phase. They add zero positive children; the retained rank mass remains 3,542. Monomial tape/movement costs remain unpriced.

This is a finite interface construction conditional on the middle's stated physical contract. It does not recertify PR2586's interior, fuse its existing 416 H1 conversions, complete the other 102 Gram/2 rows, admit a supplier or change kappa.

## Task and overlap

Base: current canonical main `b4560d9e7216f72b73c5aa940ac099c05e33ccf9`, priority revision 5. Refined card: `p104-side-correction`; [task, exact pins and scope](https://github.com/Arham-Tahir64/integer-mult-bounds/blob/92436c36b720133bd92599972bce78233ca43ea8/research/p104-intrinsic-physical-dual/TASK.json). [Shared investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2647).

Direct dependency: PR2586 `7953c9a8f788a8de5cf2ced63d9a61b67c22c6f1`; its word is retained byte-for-byte as authenticated data. Related heads: PR2497 `7f2cf129d42030d3eb3975b7d1b07392c6d32a1b`, PR2551 `249c4034da118da35f1e6009744b81461172bc61`, PR2550 `8af7c324714866afa199e4b7bf80a8f82e56d6f3`.

The explicit bridge is outside PR2586's scope. Discussion2619's 416 H1 endpoint-fusion work remains complementary. Existing forward/backward/complementary adapters are retained ingredients; the ordinary inverse-transpose identity is standard. The new result binds the intrinsic physical boundary, literal conjugated recipes and every column using a separate closed-form checker. Final refresh: 836 fully paginated open PRs at 16:49:25 UTC and 1,301 Discussion body/comment/reply records at 16:52:17 UTC, without warnings. Metadata searches do not cover arbitrary diffs or unpublished work. Main and PR2586 heads were rechecked unchanged. Coverage and limitations are recorded in TASK.json.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-intrinsic-physical-dual
```

CPython 3.12.14 registered replay passes. Exact checks cover 208 adapters, 106,496 columns, 14,400 root pairings, complete regenerated payload/receipt and six semantic faults. Six behavioral tests pass on both CPython 3.12.14 and 3.14.7, including optimized Git-free export, source/predecessor/payload/receipt rejection and exclusive output. `git diff --check` passes.

No predecessor executable or Clifford compiler is imported. The README supplies the mathematical composition argument; finite arithmetic does not certify the middle's logical/native correctness, owners, rounded private erasure, precision, all-size lifting or a complete moment. Those checks, the selected cold replay and independent human review were not performed. Hosted CI is separate evidence.

## Credit

Arham Tahir, with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in derivation, code, checks and writing. Apache-2.0; no subagents or independent human review. Credit ywz65/2586/2497, Nick Petalas/2550, PR2551 and the retained P104/native lineage: Ross Richardson/2445, commdata2338, Hiroki Kumazaki, Philippe Van Velzen, Chafik Boukhalfa/1991, Rohan Arun/1972, Adam Gall/1940, Josie Elliston/1071, Ali Romman/1125/1862, icekylinx/531 and their predecessors. Exact source pins and copied-word attribution are preserved in the package.

## Open next questions

The package README/TASK specify the next bounded task: bind one actual caller to these intrinsic wrappers and the pinned middle, then price monomial movement, descending edges, private returns and restoration in a complete boundary/cost ledger. Routing/owners, idle charges, rounded zero erasure, precision and all-size admission remain blockers. This session stops at the finite bridge; no implementation expansion is proposed.
